I fixed the bug in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py` (`build_format_selector`). All 14 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` now pass, including `test_youtube_format_selection`.

The format-spec parser mishandled a `/` choice that was followed by `,`, as in `bestvideo/best,bestaudio`. After parsing the choice it added it to the selector list and cleared the current selector. The following `,` then appended `None` to the list. Building the selector function crashed on that `None`.

The `/` branch now keeps the choice as the current selector, so the next `,` or the end of the spec adds it once.
